content.short: Shrapnel is a high-fidelity AAA extraction shooter featuring true digital ownership and a creator-led modding suite.
content.description:
Shrapnel is a premier AAA extraction-based first-person shooter built on Unreal Engine 5, designed to bring professional-grade gaming to the Web3 ecosystem. Originally developed on an Avalanche L1 subnet, the game provides players with true digital ownership of their in-game assets, including weapons, equipment, and cosmetic items. Shrapnel features a high-stakes competitive environment where player effort is recognized through real-world value and a robust "modding" suite that empowers creators to build and monetize their own virtual content.

Following its strategic migration to GalaChain to facilitate global expansion, Shrapnel continues to bridge the gap between high-fidelity gaming and decentralized technology. The ecosystem is powered by the $SHRAP token, which facilitates in-game transactions, governance, and incentive coordination. Through its commitment to skill-based play and community-driven development, Shrapnel is building a more interactive and meritocratic virtual world for the next generation of gamers, where they have total sovereignty over their digital inventory.
content.meta: Shrapnel is a AAA extraction shooter on Avalanche and GalaChain featuring NFT ownership and a creator economy.
